tasks.spec:
You are building a small billed-smoke harness in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example; run `.venv/bin/python`. No network and no live call EVER during this task (tests patch the network and the call function; never run the harness with --run). Do not git commit. NEVER print, log or write any credential. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: new scripts/ringer/environment_narration/classifier_smoke.py and new tests/test_environment_classifier_smoke.py. Read-only reuse of scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py (import its helpers; do not edit it) and tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py (copy its hermetic style).

WHY: the Worker now calls Llama 3.3 70B with NO JSON mode and default sampling for every request. Two short product calls were only ever measured in JSON mode: (a) the item-name matcher, payload built by ItemFactsProvider._match_payload(command, []) in storygame/runtime/item_facts.py (system _MATCH_SYSTEM, max_tokens 300, reply must be a JSON object with `refers` (list of strings) and `same_as` (object)); (b) ItemFactsProvider.second_call_update's payload (system _SECOND_CALL_SYSTEM, user = THINGS block + PLAYER + STORY, max_tokens 400, reply a JSON object `item_facts` mapping thing names to {place, condition}). We need to know whether the 70B still answers these as clean, product-decodable JSON without JSON mode.

BUILD classifier_smoke.py with three modes like smoke_direct.py: `--dry` (prints the plan: calls, token estimate, USD ceiling; no network, no credentials needed), `--run` (billed; refuses unless `--confirm`, `--max-calls N` and `--max-usd X` are all given and the plan's ceiling <= X; writes rows after every call; one answered attempt per slot, no retries, no replacements; stops on auth/quota errors), `--report` (renders every call: command or narration, expected, raw reply text, strict-valid, product-decoded, shape-valid, correct, latency). Reuse smoke_direct's credential loading, redaction, request building, HTTP call and usage/price code wherever it fits (read it first); the request body must be exactly what the Worker's 70B profile sends: model @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast, messages [system, user], max_tokens, NO response_format, NO temperature.

THE PLAN (fixed constants in the script): build prompts hermetically (no network) from the real package data/stories/continuity-initiative with the stubbing helpers in scripts/ringer/environment_narration/screen.py / baseline.py / the boarding probe those use (read how baseline.py builds a provider with stubbed Jev and item facts; set provider.observe_automatically = False). MATCHER cases, 5 samples each: 'Enter the truck.' (expects refers to include the truck), 'Examine my laptop.' (the laptop), 'Open the drawer.' at the kitchen start (the drawer), 'Look around.' (expects refers may be empty; correct = valid shape and no name outside the offered THINGS). SECOND-CALL cases, 5 samples each: three STORY texts taken VERBATIM from real earlier 70B replies in bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-nojsonwide-rows.json (a file that may be absent in a clean checkout: if absent or too few usable narrations, fall back to three short fixed STORY sentences written in the script that move the laptop, open the drawer, and change nothing) - expected: the changed thing is listed with a sensible place; the unchanged case returns an empty item_facts. 7 cases x 5 = 35 calls. Compute the USD ceiling from byte-length/3 input estimates and the max_tokens at the 70B prices (input 0.293, output 2.253 per million tokens); it must come out under $0.05.

SCORING (pure functions, unit-tested): strict = json.loads(text) is an object; product_decoded = what storygame.runtime.cloudflare.CloudflareTurnProvider._decode_narration would return (call it through a minimal helper or reproduce it by calling that method on an instance built with object.__new__ plus the attributes it touches; prefer calling the real method so the measurement is the product's); shape_valid per call kind as described above; correct per the expectations above. Record latency, usage tokens and the response model name.

TESTS FIRST (hermetic: patch urlopen/socket to fail the test if reached; patch the call function with a fake): plan size 35 and ceiling < 0.05; --run refuses without --confirm/--max-calls/--max-usd and when the ceiling exceeds --max-usd, without touching the network; request body has no response_format and no temperature; scoring functions on valid, fenced, stray-quote, truncated and non-JSON replies; the report prints raw reply text for every row; rows written after every call and a stop on a 401/429 fake; no credential value in written files. Run them and see them fail, then build, then pass. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; run `scripts/ringer/environment_narration/classifier_smoke.py --dry --out /tmp/cs.json` and report its plan line.
